evals.prompt: Migrate this app from react-i18next to Lingui. Keep the German translations working. Don't run npm install, lingui commands, or builds — make all code, config, and catalog changes, and tell me exactly which commands to run afterwards.
evals.expected_output: A complete migration: i18next removed from code and package.json, Lingui packages and config added, components rewritten to Lingui macros with the plural pair collapsed into ICU, German catalog content preserved, and follow-up commands listed.
expectations: No imports from i18next, react-i18next, or i18next-browser-languagedetector remain under src/

package.json no longer lists i18next, react-i18next, or i18next-browser-languagedetector, and adds @lingui/core, @lingui/react, @lingui/cli plus a macro transform path (@lingui/vite-plugin with a Babel or SWC lingui macro plugin)
A lingui config file exists with sourceLocale en and locales including de
vite.config.ts wires the Lingui macro transform (the lingui vite plugin plus the babel or swc macro plugin configuration)
The note_one/note_other plural pair becomes a single ICU plural via the Plural component or plural macro — no ternary between two strings
The welcome message keeps its rich-text formatting (<strong>) and interpolated name via Lingui's Trans macro
The app is wrapped in I18nProvider, and the language switcher uses i18n.load/i18n.activate (a dynamic catalog import is acceptable)
German translations are preserved: a de catalog (.po or documented conversion output) contains the existing German strings from de.json
The final answer lists the follow-up commands: installing dependencies, lingui extract, and lingui compile
